quotes.text: // The first check for hasEncryptedParts may produce false positives.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: MimeTree starts encryption detection while child parts are still being built. hasPgpMimeHeaders tests multipart/encrypted plus the application/pgp-encrypted protocol. isPgpMime additionally requires two subParts before decryption. The emitter can therefore identify encrypted content before retaining every body. Manual predicate naming proposal here: use has…Headers for header evidence and is… for a fully checked structure; state the extra structural condition at the later boundary. A header match can be a false positive, so it is not proof decryption succeeded. Filter-mode callers opt into these changes, while the base emitter ignores the extra flags when filter mode is disabled.
title: Name an early header predicate separately from a complete MIME structure check
